mapper.select: SELECT wr.id AS routine_id, m.id AS member_id, m.name AS member_name, wr.title, wr.description, wr.start_date, wr.end_date, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM routine_exercises re WHERE re.routine_id = wr.id) AS exercise_count FROM workout_routines wr JOIN trainers t ON t.id = wr.trainer_id AND t.user_id = #{userId} JOIN members m ON m.id = wr.member_id WHERE wr.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (#{memberId} IS NULL OR m.id = #{memberId}) ORDER BY wr.updated_at DESC

SELECT wr.id AS routine_id, m.id AS member_id, m.name AS member_name, wr.title, wr.description, wr.start_date, wr.end_date, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM routine_exercises re WHERE re.routine_id = wr.id) AS exercise_count FROM workout_routines wr JOIN trainers t ON t.id = wr.trainer_id AND t.user_id = #{userId} JOIN members m ON m.id = wr.member_id WHERE wr.id = #{routineId} AND wr.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT id AS exercise_id, exercise_name, display_order, target_sets, target_reps_min, target_reps_max, target_weight, rest_seconds, memo FROM routine_exercises WHERE routine_id = #{routineId} ORDER BY display_order, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workout_routines(member_id, trainer_id, title, description, status, start_date, end_date) VALUES(#{memberId}, #{trainerId}, #{title}, #{description}, 'ACTIVE', #{startDate}, #{endDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE workout_routines SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{routineId} AND trainer_id = #{trainerId}

UPDATE workout_routines wr JOIN trainers t ON t.id = wr.trainer_id SET wr.status = 'CANCELLED', wr.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE wr.id = #{routineId} AND t.user_id = #{userId} AND wr.status = 'ACTIVE'
